limitations: Synthetic explicit AI-authored labels are independent of the checked score function, not independent human or market observations.

Scenario holdout was consumed before QA-01/01b. The generic policy was corrected after substantive review of counterexamples; final measurements are regression checks, not an untouched holdout. Original labels, partitions and shared-fit weights remain unchanged.
All seven ranking methods share the same current eligibility gate and exact inputs. Alias regression is a separately disclosed equivalent-spelling diagnostic view.

Common need-fit precedes linked-proof completeness. At equal fit/completeness, comparable queues use local quality plus up to 3 FSP points; available heads use FSP then alias/id, not technical group names or raw cross-bank result scales. All losses are retained.
Freshness uses fixed 30/90/180-day bands so near-timestamp differences do not suppress local quality. Salary unknown is excluded from the shared factor sum, not treated as a failed condition.
Precision@5 includes short/empty queries with denominator five. Null nDCG/recall are counted explicitly, not converted into perfect values.
The fixture rubricKey and successful-attempt records are constructed; structural grouping does not prove equal human difficulty or actual hiring success.
A fixed pseudo-random seed is one diagnostic ordering, not a repeated random-trial estimate.
